constraints.name: ck_checklist_items_completed_by_needs_time
constraints.expression: completed_at IS NOT NULL OR completed_by IS NULL

constraints.name: ck_checklist_items_shared_has_no_owner
constraints.expression: NOT is_shared OR owner_membership_id IS NULL

constraints.name: ck_memos_deleted_by_needs_time
constraints.expression: deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR deleted_by IS NULL

constraints.name: ck_photos_deleted_by_needs_time
constraints.expression: deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR deleted_by IS NULL

constraints.name: ck_places_latitude_in_range
constraints.expression: latitude IS NULL OR (latitude >= -90 AND latitude <= 90)

constraints.name: ck_places_longitude_in_range
constraints.expression: longitude IS NULL OR (longitude >= -180 AND longitude <= 180)

constraints.name: ck_schedule_items_times_in_order
constraints.expression: end_at IS NULL OR start_at IS NULL OR end_at >= start_at

constraints.name: ck_stays_checkout_after_checkin
constraints.expression: check_out_at IS NULL OR check_in_at IS NULL OR check_out_at > check_in_at

constraints.name: ck_transports_arrival_after_departure
constraints.expression: arrival_at IS NULL OR departure_at IS NULL OR arrival_at >= departure_at
